meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: 装上后，你让 Claude 检查 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装状况时，它会先拉取最新源码再逐项比对，最后给出一份 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告，每条结论都附上对应的命令输出或文件作为证据；它只诊断，不改动你的配置和仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex、omo-codex 等关键词，或 Codex 在安装、更新、改配置后行为异常、疑似版本过旧时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 LazyCodex 健康检查，看看安装有没有问题
say.note: 输出带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告

say.text: Codex 更新后行为怪怪的，帮我诊断一下
say.note: 会拉取最新源码对比，找出版本漂移

say.text: 检查我的 Astra 就绪状态和 Codex 版本
say.note: 核对是否达到 0.153.1 版本门槛

howto.what_en: After installing, when you ask Claude to check your LazyCodex and Codex CLI setup it syncs the latest sources, compares them item by item, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where every verdict cites the command output or file behind it. It only diagnoses; it does not change your config or repos.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex or omo-codex, or when Codex misbehaves after an install, update, or config change and may be out of date.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex health check on my install
Codex acts oddly after updating — please diagnose it
say_en.note: Pulls latest sources and compares for drift

say_en.text: Check my Astra readiness and Codex version
